reading_method: Independent source-only extraction. Visually audit complete Poppler 150 dpi pages and 400 dpi figure crops; read the identifiable vector stroke centers from pdftocairo SVG paths at five specified invariant masses. Linear sampling within the published polyline is graphical digitization, never model interpolation. Caption line styles are checked against SVG dash arrays. Values are rounded to six decimals; fixed conservative reading errors include stroke width, calibration, sampling and crossings. No model output or fitted scale enters these readings.

12.ambiguity_notes: Dotted, solid, dash-dot and double-dash-dot strokes are identifiable; crossing tails outside chosen masses were not sampled. Caption double dashed dotted corresponds to SVG dash + dot + dot (4.182 2.091 0.209 2.091 0.209 2.091).

13.ambiguity_notes: Stroke identities are readable, but individual kernels are not separately available through the whole-family diagnostic API. Every point stays unresolved for source-to-model mapping. No individual stroke is compared to a coherent family sum.

14.ambiguity_notes: Solid and dashed centerlines are independently readable even near their crossing using SVG path styles. The dotted Eq.43 record is reused exactly; reduced coherent API capability is absent and recorded as unresolved.

19.ambiguity_notes: Reuse the audited solid full-model point at 1.202 GeV, with 0.10 microbarn reading uncertainty. Dashed reduced and dash-dot phenomenological curves are not additional digitized inputs in this increment.
